migration_name: 库存汇总表口径调整 - 增加在途库存
source_sql: SELECT report_date, warehouse_code, SUM(stock_qty) as total_stock FROM warehouse.inventory WHERE status = 'IN_STOCK' GROUP BY report_date, warehouse_code
target_sql: SELECT report_date, warehouse_code, SUM(stock_qty) as total_stock FROM warehouse.inventory WHERE status IN ('IN_STOCK', 'IN_TRANSIT') GROUP BY report_date, warehouse_code
manual_remark: 业务需求：2025年6月起库存统计口径调整，在途库存纳入统计

migration_name: 出入库汇总表字段重命名
source_sql: SELECT report_date, SUM(in_qty) as inbound, SUM(out_qty) as outbound FROM warehouse.movement GROUP BY report_date
target_sql: SELECT report_date, SUM(inbound_qty) as inbound_total, SUM(outbound_qty) as outbound_total FROM warehouse.daily_movement GROUP BY report_date
manual_remark: 表结构变更：movement表拆分为daily_movement，字段名标准化

migration_name: 库存价值计算逻辑修复
source_sql: SELECT sku, stock_qty * cost as stock_value FROM warehouse.inventory
target_sql: SELECT sku, stock_qty * unit_cost as stock_value FROM warehouse.inventory
manual_remark: Bug修复：字段名错误，cost应为unit_cost，导致5月下旬报表数据异常

source_sql: SELECT sku, stock_qty / daily_sales as turnover_days FROM warehouse.inventory
target_sql: SELECT sku, stock_qty / NULLIF(avg_daily_sales_30d, 0) as turnover_days FROM warehouse.inventory
manual_remark: 优化：使用30天均值避免单日销量波动影响，处理除零错误
